license_note: Meta publishes the weights, tokenizer, and original checkpoints under the custom Llama 3.2 Community License, which carries attribution and redistribution duties, a "Built with Llama" display requirement, a "Llama" naming requirement for derived models, a 700 million monthly-active-user commercial threshold, and an incorporated acceptable-use policy. The policy's European Union exclusion applies only to multimodal Llama 3.2 models, so it does not bind this text-only release, but the use-based terms still make it source-available.

access_boundary: This record represents the meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct release of September 25, 2024 at Hugging Face commit 9213176726f574b556790deb65791e0c5aa438b6. The base 1B model, the sibling size, the quantized SpinQuant and QLoRA variants Meta describes in the same card, fine-tunes, Meta-hosted products, and independent serving providers are separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Meta publishes Transformers-compatible Safetensors weights and an original-format checkpoint in the same repository (model.safetensors file plus original consolidated checkpoint)
The model card names the governing license, a release date, and a static-model status statement
tradeoffs: Artifact access is gated behind a contact-information agreement and the custom license carries attribution, scale, and acceptable-use restrictions
The model card documents no hosted serving paths, so independent availability must be verified with each operator
